question: Do command, dependency, documentation, and deployment surfaces retain redundant authorities after prior cleanup?
verified_evidence: Root Makefile is the documented repository gate and invokes all three Node suites plus pipeline pytest; nested Makefile is a legitimate pipeline-scoped operator entry point with download/help.
GitHub Pages workflow deliberately owns only the independently deployed quiz boundary.
Knowledge command tests read the executable .claude/commands specifications directly rather than duplicating their implementation.
youtube-transcript-pipeline/README.md presents direct OpenAI key/credit and GPT-4o-mini facts, while runtime defaults to the local copilot bridge, placeholder bridge key, and LLM_MODEL=gpt-4o.
The README claims 100% and 37/37 tests; the fresh authoritative run collected and passed 42 Python tests, in addition to all Node suites.
No suspicious tracked generated, database, backup, env, node_modules, pycache, or coverage artifacts were found.
The LOCAL_KB_ROOT/root_id cascade was already reported on 2026-07-31 and was not duplicated.
current_conclusion: Complete: one verified finding. Pipeline documentation is a stale second authority for volatile provider/model/auth and test facts. Other examined boundaries are legitimate or previously reported.
